# Third-party files bundled with rockconnect

These files are served from this folder (not from a CDN) so the site works offline, sends no visitor data to
third parties and can use a strict Content-Security-Policy. They are unmodified and keep their own licences.

| File | Project | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| bootstrap.min.css, bootstrap.bundle.min.js | Bootstrap 4.6.2, https://getbootstrap.com | MIT |
| jquery.min.js | jQuery 3.6.0, https://jquery.com | MIT |
| fonts/inter-*.woff2 | Inter, The Inter Project Authors, https://github.com/rsms/inter (via Fontsource) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

| ../../wordlists_data/*.txt | List of Dirty, Naughty, Obscene, and Otherwise Bad Words (LDNOOBW), https://github.com/LDNOOBW/List-of-Dirty-Naughty-Obscene-and-Otherwise-Bad-Words | CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE.txt in that folder); used as supplied, with very short and everyday-word entries skipped when loaded |

fonts.css is written for this project (it only points at the font files).
